# North Star — literature-review (brought in-folder 2026-07-25)

> The Crucible-locked origin lives at `planning/crucible/NORTH-STAR.md`. This file puts
> the operative statement at the skill root (the other deep-governed skills carry one;
> this one governed from a planning subdir only).

Rigorously ingest, corroborate, and synthesize the literature on a question: a
deterministic snowball search with PRISMA discipline, ONE-call-per-paper claim
extraction with deterministic quote grounding, weighted consensus synthesis
(OBSERVED > CORROBORATED > CLAIMED ladder), and a final adversarial pass through
researchPrime's real governed round — outputting a source-grounded Assumptions Ledger
+ comparison matrix. Crucible-like mixed-initiative: the run HALTS at the stage-3 gate
for the user.

Load-bearing honesty criteria:
1. **Each stage honest about what ran** — no `--live` ⇒ an explicit "extraction/
   verification did NOT run" stamp; missing seats ⇒ the honest-stop ("Nothing was
   derived; nothing was fabricated"), `crossModel: false` recorded.
2. **The evidence base never shrinks silently** — a failed reference expansion is a
   PRISMA `fetch-failed` exclusion naming what was lost (2026-07-25; journal 0002).
3. **Breadth is a criterion, not a hope** — the North Star asks for broad exploratory
   search across sources; a single-provider walk is the documented residual (OpenAlex
   fallback) and its absence is stated, not papered over.
4. **The venue whitelist RANKS by default; it excludes only on explicit operator opt-in.**
